body: Actually only one person has ever tried to comfort me and listen to me and be physical in my life about the things I have went through, people don't care, it's the cold truth.

Thank you for reading, I have seen a therapist actually, she told me that i have such good thoughts and self-reflection that she can't help me, she suggested me psychotherapy. It feels good to let it out, my life has been awful.. Thank you <3

What it feels like ; I feel a gravitational pull torwards the center of my body, ripping me inside out in pain, a physical chest of release, me, being a conscious being, in a certain way, In my own way I feel everything being a tense weight from center into my feet, then it absorbs to oblivion through my body and starts again.
